decisions.explanation: An active free checker variable is by definition a free checker variable that does not appear on the left-hand side of a checker variable assignment; in simulation its value is chosen by assume-based solving and is constrained only by the assume set, so the standard does not fix a value that an expected output could compare. A checker variable updated by always_ff, like the counters of this test, is inactive, so the Postponed rule for past values does not apply to it.
